title: tf-test-agent report
description: Structured result the Terraform test agent returns at the end of a run. CI renders it into the pull request comment; nothing in it is trusted without the independent verify job.

decision.description: tests_created: at least one new test file was committed. tests_updated: only existing test files changed. no_tests_needed: the change does not warrant test changes (say why in summary). blocked: the agent could not produce passing tests (say why).

summary.description: Two to five sentences for the reviewer: what changed, what was done about tests, what they should look at.

change_kind.description: What kind of change the pull request made to this unit.

action.description: What the agent did to this unit's tests.

tests_run.description: Result of the agent's own terraform test runs, per unit, on the final committed state.

findings.description: Things a human reviewer should know about the infrastructure code. Report only; never change .tf files.

skills_used.description: Names of the skills the agent applied during the run.

limitations.description: What the produced tests cannot show, and anything the agent could not verify.
